name: @orchestrator/graph
description: The orchestrator's domain, platform-free: the state machine (reduce() and its transition table), the labels/events/routines vocabulary, translating a GitHub webhook or a routine's signal into an event, the label changes a rule makes, and the merge-gate decision. No I/O and no Cloudflare: worker/ wires it to Durable Objects, D1 and GitHub, and anything else could. Imported by name (@orchestrator/graph/<module>), as TypeScript source: every consumer bundles or runs it through Vite or esbuild, so there's no build step.
